video_prompt: One continuous horizontal full-frame shot from the first frame to the last, filmed on a phone front camera on a tripod. The woman — an East Asian woman about 26 years old with light skin and glossy straight black hair cut in a shoulder-length bob with blunt bangs, small silver hoop earrings, wearing a soft heather-grey hoodie — sits alone in a calm bedroom with a sage-green painted wall behind her, a simple framed botanical leaf print, a rattan armchair and a tall leafy plant in the corner, a soft white duvet at the edge of the frame, gentle daylight, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same position in the frame, same distance from the camera. The camera stays still and the room around her stays still and calm. She talks straight into the camera, sincere and a little worried, like confiding in a friend, with small natural head movements and small nods; her shoulders stay relaxed, her face stays centered in the frame, and between sentences her head settles back into the same upright, centered, front-facing resting pose she has in the first frame.
